$comment: City plan: the coordinator's contract for a multi-district build. Every district agent receives this file plus its own district entry. Placeholder text starting with 'Replace'/'Describe'/'Name the' fails validation.

city.name: Replace with the city's name
city.promise: Replace with one sentence: place, era, hour, weather, and what a visitor discovers
city.palette_notes: Describe the city-wide palette roles: value ladder, shade tint, the one or two saturated accents and who owns them

shared_kit.$comment: Built BEFORE any district by the kit stage. Districts import generators from here only — no district may define its own building generator.
builders_required: Name the building/prop generators every district will need, e.g. rowhouse, warehouse, quaycrane
signage_tenants: Name the tenant/sign identities the kit's signage tables must carry

districts.name: Replace with the district's name
districts.brief: Replace with 2-4 sentences of narrative intent: who lives/works here, what happened ten minutes ago, what the player should feel crossing it

waypoints.name: Name a place a player must be able to reach

vista_cameras.name: vista-name
vista_cameras.subject: Name the Object3D this vista exists to show
